name: Bayou Grove Family Dentistry
license: Dentists licensed by the Texas State Board of Dental Examiners.

cta.label: Book an Appointment
cta.text: Call or send a request, and our front desk will find a time that works for you and check your benefits before you come in.

hero.title: Unhurried dental care for the whole family.
hero.lead: Cleanings, fillings, crowns and implants in one calm office, with a dentist who explains every option before anything is done.

highlights.title: Same-day emergencies
highlights.text: Call before noon with a toothache or a broken tooth and we will see you that day.

highlights.title: Insurance checked first
highlights.text: We confirm your benefits and give you the cost before treatment starts.

highlights.title: Gentle with nervous patients
highlights.text: Nitrous oxide and oral sedation for anyone who dreads the chair.

overview.title: Everything your smile needs, under one roof.
overview.text: Pick a treatment to see what it involves, or call and talk it through with our front desk.

services.title: Cleanings & Exams
services.text: A thorough cleaning, digital X-rays when they are due, and an exam that catches small problems while they are still small.
services.lead: Most patients see us twice a year. Each visit is a cleaning with a hygienist and an exam with the dentist, who walks you through anything worth watching.

covers.title: Cleaning
covers.text: Plaque and tartar removed, teeth polished, and tips for the spots that need more attention at home.

covers.title: Digital X-rays
covers.text: Low-dose images, taken only when they are due, to see between teeth and below the gums.

covers.title: Oral cancer screening
covers.text: A quick check of the tongue, cheeks and throat at every exam.

questions.q: How often should I come in?
questions.a: Twice a year suits most people. If your gums need more care, the dentist may suggest every three or four months.

services.title: Fillings & Crowns
services.text: Tooth-colored fillings for small cavities and crowns for teeth that need more strength, matched to the shade of your own.
services.lead: A cavity caught early is a quick filling. A tooth that is cracked or heavily filled may need a crown to protect it for years to come.

services.title: Dental Implants
services.text: A single missing tooth or a full arch replaced with implants placed and restored in our office.
services.lead: An implant replaces the root of a missing tooth and carries a crown that looks and bites like your own. Planning starts with a 3D scan.

covers.title: Consultation and 3D scan
covers.text: We check the bone, plan the position and give you the full cost up front.

covers.title: Placement
covers.text: The implant is placed in one visit, with sedation available.

covers.title: Crown
covers.text: After healing, a custom crown is attached and matched to your other teeth.

services.title: Teeth Whitening
services.text: Several shades brighter in a single visit, or gradually at home with custom trays.

services.title: Invisalign
services.summary: Clear aligners for teens and adults.
services.text: Straighter teeth with clear aligners you can take out to eat, checked every few weeks in the office.

services.title: Emergency Dentistry
services.text: Toothaches, broken teeth and swelling seen the same day whenever we can, with relief as the first step.

about.title: A neighborhood practice that takes its time.
text: Bayou Grove Family Dentistry has cared for Baytown families since 2009. We book longer appointments than most offices so there is time to answer questions and nobody feels rushed.
Patients range from toddlers at their first visit to grandparents with implants, and many families have been with us for more than a decade.

values.title: Costs before care
values.text: You see the price and what insurance covers before any treatment begins.

values.title: Comfort first
values.text: Blankets, headphones and sedation options for anyone who is nervous.

values.title: On time
values.text: We keep to the schedule, so your hour is your hour.

owner.name: Dr. Elena Marsh
owner.text: Dr. Marsh earned her D.D.S. at the UTHealth School of Dentistry in Houston and opened Bayou Grove in 2009. She lives in Baytown with her family and spends her free time on the water at Cedar Bayou.

team.name: Dr. Elena Marsh
team.bio: Dr. Marsh founded the practice in 2009 and sees patients of every age.

team.name: Dr. Samuel Ortiz
team.bio: Dr. Ortiz focuses on implants and restorative care, and sees patients in English and Spanish.

team.name: Rosa Delgado
team.bio: Rosa has cleaned Baytown smiles for fifteen years and is known for her gentle touch.

steps.title: Book your visit
steps.text: Call or send a request, and we will find a time and check your benefits.

steps.title: Meet the team
steps.text: A short tour, a few questions about your health, and any X-rays that are due.

steps.title: Your exam
steps.text: The dentist looks over everything and shows you what they see on a screen.

steps.title: Your plan
steps.text: Clear options with costs, so you can decide what to do and when.

facts.heading: Payment and financing
facts.text: We accept cash, all major credit cards, HSA and FSA cards, and CareCredit for treatment paid over time.

reviews.author: Maria G.
reviews.text: I have been nervous at the dentist my whole life, and this is the first office where I never felt rushed. They explained everything before they started.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: Broke a tooth on a Monday morning and was seen before lunch. The crown looks exactly like my other teeth.

reviews.author: Priya R.
reviews.text: Our whole family comes here, from my four-year-old to my parents. The front desk always sorts out the insurance for us.

faqs.a: Yes. We see children from their first tooth, and many families come in together.

faqs.q: What if I do not have insurance?
faqs.a: We give you the cost before treatment and offer financing through CareCredit.
